cohort: 200 pregnant women in Bengaluru, India, between 12-36 weeks of gestation with hemoglobin levels < 10.9g/dL.
finding: Women with severe anemia in pregnancy experienced a higher incidence of adverse maternal outcomes, including postpartum hemorrhage and prolonged hospital stays, and adverse perinatal outcomes, such as preterm delivery, low birth weight, and increased NICU admission rates.
mod_finding: Women with severe anemia had increased rates of cesarean sections (35%) compared to those with mild anemia.
birth_weight: average of 2.2 kg (for babies of severely anemic mothers), low birth weight (as an outcome)
gest_age: 12-36 weeks (for participant recruitment), preterm delivery (as an outcome)
